cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(swag_framebuffer_fixtures LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
find_package(Qt5 5.15 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets)
find_package(Qt5FbSupport REQUIRED)
option(SWAG_FIXTURE_ASAN "Instrument regression fixtures with AddressSanitizer" OFF)
foreach(fixture vncws_backingstore vncws_reentrant vncws_paint_benchmark)
    add_executable(${fixture} ${fixture}.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(${fixture} PRIVATE Qt5::Widgets)
    target_compile_definitions(${fixture} PRIVATE QT_FORCE_ASSERTS)
    if(SWAG_FIXTURE_ASAN)
        target_compile_options(${fixture} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
        target_link_options(${fixture} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
    endif()
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(vncws_backingstore PRIVATE Qt5::GuiPrivate Qt5::FbSupportPrivate)
